privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1_text: At Time2Wish, we only collect the data necessary to provide you with the best possible service. This includes your name, email address, and the birthday information you add (names, birthdates, and associated notes).
privacy.sec2_text: Your data is used exclusively to:
privacy.sec2_li2: Send you birthday reminders via email or notification.
privacy.sec2_li3: Improve the user experience and application features.
privacy.sec3_text: The security of your data is our absolute priority. We use advanced encryption protocols to protect your personal information against unauthorized access.
privacy.sec4_text: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. Your data remains strictly confidential within Time2Wish.
privacy.sec5_text: You have the right to access, modify, or delete your personal data at any time directly from your profile settings. For any specific request, please contact support.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.sec1_text: By creating an account and using the Time2Wish app, you agree to be bound by these terms of use. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our service.
terms.sec2_text: Time2Wish is a service designed to help you remember and celebrate the birthdays of your loved ones. You agree to:
terms.sec2_li1: Provide accurate information when creating your account.
terms.sec2_li2: Not use the service for illegal, abusive, or spam purposes.
terms.sec2_li3: Maintain the confidentiality of your password and account.
terms.sec3_text: Gift suggestions and messages generated by our artificial intelligence are provided for informational purposes. Time2Wish does not guarantee the accuracy or availability of suggested products. You remain responsible for the messages you choose to send.
terms.sec4_text: We strive to keep Time2Wish accessible 24/7. However, we reserve the right to temporarily suspend the service for maintenance or updates.
terms.sec5_text: You can delete your account at any time. We also reserve the right to suspend or delete an account in the event of a violation of these terms.
terms.content: By using Time2Wish, you agree to our terms of use. We are committed to protecting your personal data and using it only for the proper functioning of the application.
terms.blocked_content: You must accept the terms of use to use Time2Wish.

support.title: Support Center
support.intro: Need help with Time2Wish? Our team is here to support you. Check out our frequently asked questions or contact us directly.
support.faq1_text: Check that you have authorized email sending from your profile settings, and ensure the dates are correctly configured (D-1, D-7, etc.).
support.faq2_text: The AI assistant uses the saved name, age, and interests to generate a unique message. The more notes you add, the better the generated message will be!
support.faq3_text: You can mass import your contacts from the dashboard via a CSV file containing the columns 'Name', 'Date', and 'Category'.
support.contact_text: Send us a message and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
